ranking_basis: Ordinal scientific prior and implementation cost only; hidden expert labels are unavailable and no numeric DTI forecast is claimed.

hypotheses.name: Active-deformation strain ridges
layers: training_features.tif band 4: second invariant of strain rate
hypotheses.physical_signature: Scale-normalized Hessian line-ridge response of log-magnitude strain at 3, 6, and 9 pixels (300/600/900 m), with a weak earthquake-density term; exact band descriptions and units must be verified before processing.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: A buried or alluvium-covered active fault may lack a mapped surface trace while deformation/seismicity remains spatially expressed; this is conditional, since strain can be diffuse and non-fault-specific.
hypotheses.prior_art_difference: H55-B proposed strain-ridge analysis but no matching prediction artifact or blocked score exists; prior candidates do not use a strain-ridge transform.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Highest plausible novel-signal upside; unknown numeric value; must be measured.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; restore ~419 MB stack mirror, verify SHA and band metadata, compute multi-scale Hessian/coherence, create mass-matched mask.

data_availability.limitations: Hash identity verified against a third-party GitHub mirror, not organizer authentication; license/provenance review remains open.

frozen_test.strain_transform: log1p(abs(x)/median(abs(nonzero(x)))) then scale-normalized absolute-Hessian line response; per-channel/scale P99.5 normalization.
frozen_test.holdout: four fixed quadrants; held-out core plus 300 m halo; catalogue and SGMC-positive >300 m from catalogue evaluated separately
frozen_test.slot_gate: must beat the current same-protocol H49 proxy-best on the preregistered comparison; public proxy pass alone cannot clear a private-label slot

hypotheses.name: Buried basement-step edges
hypotheses.physical_signature: Multi-scale lateral basement-depth curvature and gravity horizontal-gradient/tilt edges, gated by conductivity contrast.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: A basement offset beneath basin fill may lack surface relief yet remain expressed by density and conductivity boundaries.
hypotheses.prior_art_difference: H55-C proposed the concept but no matching raster candidate or blocked score exists; it differs from radiometric-edge and lidar-scarp candidates.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; exact bands, units, nodata, and lithologic confounding must be audited.

data_availability.limitations: Owner mirror rather than organizer-authenticated original; terms and independent coverage are unresolved.

hypotheses.name: Lidar scarp trace persistence
hypotheses.physical_signature: Select low-amplitude height steps persisting across adjacent 100 m cells with compatible strike, rather than isolated scarp pixels.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Subtle young scarps can be unmapped or omitted from generalized fault inventories; line persistence tests a structural trace rather than a point anomaly.
hypotheses.prior_art_difference: H52 used point additions and H53-A used strike-coherent point selection; H55-D proposed trace persistence but did not implement it. This is not claimed as wholly novel lidar use.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Moderate but unverified; previous related point-based candidate failed its proxy gate.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium/high; regional product is local, but tile/source coverage and facing_at/strike semantics require review.

data_availability.limitations: Product is a derived, owner-mirrored regional mosaic; do not infer complete official coverage from the two pilot tiles.

hypotheses.name: Magnetic analytic-signal and tilt edges
layers: USGS GeoDAWN airborne magnetic grid(s) from DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ
hypotheses.physical_signature: Multi-scale analytic-signal magnitude and tilt-angle edge coherence, distinct from gamma/radiometric edges.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Basement structure beneath cover can create magnetic contrasts without a topographic scarp; a structural edge may therefore be absent from surface catalogues.
hypotheses.prior_art_difference: H53-RadEdge used radiometric K/Th/U/total-count edges and failed its proxy test; no candidate in this repository computes an analytic signal from the official magnetic grids.
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Moderate/unknown; magnetic contrasts are non-unique and may be lithologic rather than fault-related.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High; download/regrid source products and verify exact footprint, flight-line artifacts, and resolution.

data_availability.verified_source_claim: USGS GeoDAWN release page describes magnetic/radiometric grids and provides a public CC0 release.
data_availability.payload_status: Not downloaded or footprint-tested for this slate.

hypotheses.name: Geochemical alteration/pathfinder anomalies
layers: USGS National Geochemical Survey sample locations and analytes B, Li, As, Hg, subject to dictionary/method audit
hypotheses.physical_signature: Method-stratified robust log-anomaly scores for a frozen analyte set, rasterized with sample-density uncertainty and tested only after media/units review.
hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Hydrothermal alteration/fluids may leave geochemical anomalies near buried pathways not mapped as faults; stream transport and lithology are major confounders.
hypotheses.prior_art_difference: No National Geochemical Survey predictor is in the current candidate outputs; this differs from airborne radiometry (H50-B/H53-RadEdge) and well/spring point observations (H55-A).
hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement: Low-to-moderate, highly uncertain; sampling density and laboratory heterogeneity could erase signal.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High; audit sample media, dates, analyte limits, coordinates, geology, and footprint coverage before modeling.

data_availability.availability: USGS page offers geographic downloads and national CSV/shapefile packages.
data_availability.payload_status: Not downloaded; exact competition-footprint sample coverage has not been verified.

separate_requested_deliverable.name: Open-world discounted Dempster-Shafer B2 x H33-D
separate_requested_deliverable.belief_surface: 300 m triangular max-credit field derived from each sparse parent mask
separate_requested_deliverable.mass_assignment: m(F)=alpha*b; m(not_F)=alpha*q*(1-b); m(Theta)=1-m(F)-m(not_F); q=0.10 means a missing source prediction is mostly ignorance, not a strong no-fault assertion.
separate_requested_deliverable.rule: canonical normalized Dempster combination; raw conflict K and residual m(Theta) exported separately
separate_requested_deliverable.primary: Bel(F) divided by its maximum inside the valid footprint; relative favorability, not calibrated probability
separate_requested_deliverable.slot_status: not cleared unless comparable spatially blocked evidence beats current best; no competition slot will be used in this session
